Read in data

```{r}
diet = read.table("diet.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
```

Problem 1a

```{r}
colors = c("blue","red","black")
plot(diet$calories, diet$weight_lost, pch = 19,col = colors[factor(diet$method)], xlab = "Calories", ylab = "Weight Lost")
legend("topright", legend = c("both", "diet", "exercise"), pch = 19, col = colors)
```

Problem 1c

```{r}
diet$exer = ifelse(diet$method == "exercise", 1, 0)
diet$both = ifelse(diet$method == "both", 1,0)
```

Problem 1d

```{r}
model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exer + both, data = diet)
summary(model)
```

Problem 1i

```{r}
model = lm(weight_lost ~ calories + exer + both, data = diet)
cov_matrix = vcov(model)
print(cov_matrix)
```
